1. Purpose & Overview
This standard governs customer service operations regarding recurring Automated Clearing House (ACH) and recurring
debit/credit card premium deductions. Contact center representatives must execute NACHA-compliant verbal
authorizations and adhere to cut-off timing windows.
2. Recurring EFT Setup & Telephonic Mandate
To establish recurring auto-debit over the phone, representatives must record the call and read the Mandatory
Telephonic Authorization Script verbatim:
Required Verbatim Script:
"By authorizing this payment today, you grant [Carrier Name] permission to debit your account ending in [Last 4 Digits] at [Financial
Institution Name] on a recurring monthly basis on the [1st/5th/15th/20th] of each month in the amount of your monthly premium,
currently $[Amount]. This authorization remains in effect until you notify us at least three (3) business days prior to the scheduled
draft date. Do you consent to these terms?"
